verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party natural-language command interface for operating Trello. The 'MCP server — Connect Trello to any AI tool' item belongs to the separate MCP-server story: the natural-language operation would happen in an external AI tool, not in Trello. 'Use AI to help write or edit content' is AI content drafting, and 'Set a due date from the card title' is narrow date parsing; neither lets a user operate the product by command, so all three are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
